headline: TriMas Sells Rapak to Ringmetall
summary: TriMas Corporation subsidiary Rapak has been acquired by Ringmetall SE with advisory support from Woodward Park Partners.
why: TriMas Corporation is a diversified global manufacturer of products for growing markets, while Ringmetall SE is a specialized industrial packaging supplier. M&A transactions of this nature impact corporate portfolio restructuring and operational focus.

impacts.name: TriMas Corporation
impacts.why: TriMas divested its Rapak subsidiary, altering its asset base and corporate structure.
